column6: Jiphtah, a town of the lowland of Judah (JOS 15:43 'And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib'), is held twice at its one verse: as jephthah-2, a place record made from Strong's H3316 (the headword it shares with the judge Jephthah, who keeps his own record), and as the gazetteer's Iphtah; the gazetteer's record keeps its point, so jephthah-2 is folded into iphtah
